exposure: three-dimensional (3D) body scanner for external pelvic assessment
pelvic measurements (obtained via Martin pelvimeter, 3D body scanner, and MR-pelvimetry)
ratio of waist girth to maternal height
cohort: 73 singleton pregnancies with intended vaginal birth from breech presentation (>36.0 weeks of gestation)
finding: A novel three-dimensional (3D) body scanner technique is at least equal to MRI in predicting successful vaginal breech delivery.
